newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus stocks continue to weaken.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus stocks continue to weaken.

text.p: Cyprus stocks retreated in the first three trading days of the week with investors waiting on the sidelines for lows before moving in, traders said.
The CSE general index closed at 80.24 points on Wednesday from 80.71 last Friday.

"The feeling on the market is that shares are close to their lowest point," said one trader. "Investors are still playing a waiting game and probably feel the market could move even lower before moving in."
The banking index fell 0.22 points from Friday's close, to 89.65 points.

Fully paid shares in the Bank of Cyprus lost two cents, closing at 334.5.. Fully paid shares of the Cyprus Popular Bank went down one cent to 325.5. The Hellenic Bank dropped half a cent 259.5. Universal Savings Bank closed unchanged at 137.
Universal Life shares rose to 371.5 from 367.5 registered on Friday. Paneuropean Insurance gained 1.5 cents, closing at 120.
Trading in Liberty Life Insurance has been suspended for the past three trading sessions pending CSE inquiries into a Paneuropean bid to buy more than 25 percent of its capital.
Cement producer Vassiliko declined 3.5 cents, closing at 156.5. Beer and wine producers Keo went up one cent to close at 111.5.
